requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-3734-4231-5929--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Phyrexian Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2760-4279-4699.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-4699.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-4699.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

5147-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
5147-5254-8122.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
5147-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

628-728-5405.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, optionally putting -1/-1 counter(s) on another creature.
Resolve the Soulstinger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

2493-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Archaeomancer.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Archaeomancer from exile to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

338-2685-5641-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2685-5641-7810.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2239-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2239-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7606.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

457-1792-4404-5645.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-5645.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Stenn.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

2608-4499-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

2113-3713-4316-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

296-3532-3581-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-3581-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2638-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2638-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2275-2541-4017.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

67-1676-5670-6720-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-6720-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Case of the Uneaten Feast and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-6720-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

2105-3499-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
2105-3499-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

5078-5741-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

345-1497-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
345-1497-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

970-1369-1742.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to remove Asmodeus from the battlefield.
970-1369-1742.description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Asmodeus's activated abilities until end of turn.
Remove Asmodeus from the battlefield.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Asmodeus's first ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar three times by discarding three cards, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 3.

3662-4872-5131.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {3}{R}{R}{R} each extra turn
3662-4872-5131.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Time Warp from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chemister from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

373-877-2292-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-2292-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

232-618-1283-4222.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
232-618-1283-4222.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {3}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1025-4782.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four snow permanents.
1025-4782.description:
On the end step before your turn, activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Stasis from the battlefield to your hand.
During either of your main phases, cast Stasis by paying {1}{U}.
While Stasis is on the battlefield, your opponent will skip their untap steps.

360-1841-1981-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
360-1841-1981-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
The Soldiers enter the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden fifty times, gaining you 100 life.
Repeat.

313-4050-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {1}.
Cormela dies, returning Corpse Dance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Corpse Dance by paying {2}{B}, putting Cormela from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

40-109-3765.description:
Cast Worldfire.
Electrostatic Field triggers.
Holding priority, cast Fork targeting Worldfire.
Resolve the copy of Worldfire, exiling all permanents and cards from players' hands and setting all player's life totals to one.
Resolve the Electrostatic Field trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.

1006-1636-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Wolfhunter's Quiver attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1006-1636-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Wolfhunter's Quiver ability by tapping it, choosing any target.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

661-890-2410.notablePrerequisites:
Sculpting Steel  is a copy of Myr Galvanizer.
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
661-890-2410.description:
Activate either Myr Galvanizer or Sculpting Steel by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
